text:
mira: Heads-up: running a narrow canary to remove unused admin privileges from billing+analytics svc roles and test KMS ephemeral grants with dual-approval + TTL. Want to validate audit traces and revocation behavior.
jamal: I can run a staging flow. Plan: create `svc-canary-reduced`, staging-key, and a dual-approval grant. Will simulate second approver with test account.
ops-bot: audit: 2 failed decrypts detected earlier from svc-analytics-legacy at 2026-03-20T02:12:03Z 026-03-20. Logged to audit-index-2026.
sophia: we should mirror prod approval semantics in staging but restrict IPs. Also add auto-revoke verification.
dan: please ensure logs include correlation_id, principal_path, kms_key_id, and approver_list. I'll add an ingest pipeline snippet to annotate trace id.
jamal: quick staging commands (short):
```bash
redwood-kms grant create --key staging-key-7 --principal svc-canary-01 --approvers jamal,mira --ttl 3600 --mode dual-approval
redwood-kms grant status --id grant-test-01
```
jamal: grant stays `pending` until both approve. Will script auto-approve for test path then validate revoke after TTL.
olivia: I'll open SEC-1428 and add acceptance criteria: no failed decrypts, revokes within TTL+5m, full audit evidence.
mira: action items:
- jamal: provision staging key + run dual-approval smoke (due Thu EOD)
- dan: update ingest pipeline + saved search for grant.revoke (due Fri)
- olivia: file SEC ticket + owners (today)
- sophia: set staging allowlist (today)
- mira: run canary and gather audit evidence, propose prod rollout after passing checks
jamal: add rotate-and-clean step to runbook so test principals are rotated and removed after canary.
dan: add incident steps for leak: hotfix key creation + immediate revoke play.
mira: no objections. we'll post canary results to #eng-security and close SEC-1428 when green. :thumbsup:
